title: Tide's Perfected Survival
description: An opinionated minecraft modpack that focuses on improving the survival experience
body:
Tide's Perfected Survival

This modpack is all about making the survival grind actually feel rewarding. Instead of adding a million confusing machines i've focused on deepening the games core loop while keeping that classic vanilla feel.

This Modpack features:

Survival That Matters – I've tweaked progression so that surviving your first week feels like a real achievement again.

Actually Cool Exploration – New landmarks and biome tweaks that make you actually want to see what’s over the next hill.

QOL Features – This modpack aims to streamline usually grindy tasks in normal minecraft.

Mob Improvements – Mobs act a bit smarter and the environment feels way more alive

Optimization – Tons of optimizations so you can play with high settings without your PC sounding like a jet engine.

Also Credits to Stackleyy, dimaxxing and tazoh i've used their modpacks and mod lists as inspiration for this Modpack
